title: Leatherman fronted Trump cyber strategy while CISA was weakened
summary: Leatherman publicly promoted the administration's cyber strategy and FBI offensive-disruption model while CISA lost major staffing and faced further budget and mission reductions.

sources.title: Ahead of the Threat Podcast:Season 2, Episode 0:Brett Leatherman
White House Goes on Cyber Offensive
sources.notes: Reports Leatherman's support for the offensive strategy and notes the strategy lacked new funding amid a resource-strapped CISA.

sources.title: How Trump 2.0 has shaped and shrunk the top U.S. cyber agency
Trump administration plans to cut cybersecurity agency's budget by $700 million
CISA takes backseat in White House AI cyber response

data.claim: Leatherman publicly fronted the Trump administration's aggressive cyber strategy and FBI disruption agenda during a period when the administration reduced CISA staffing, capacity and institutional influence.

inferences: The strategy creates an accountability contradiction between publicly demanding greater national resilience and weakening the principal civilian asset-response agency.
caveats: No public evidence reviewed shows that Leatherman designed, requested or privately supported the CISA cuts.
FBI threat response and CISA asset response are distinct statutory and policy functions.
Publicly representing an administration strategy does not imply agreement with every budget decision.

methods: cross-source CISA staffing and budget comparison
